description: The gait styles of the corpus' dinosaurs and dragons (on two legs or four) (D:\work\glb_skinned_meshes: 202 styles from the walking clips and the steady stretches of the takes of its models): how fast the body goes, how long a step is, how much of a cycle a foot is in the air, how high it lifts, how far the hips bob and when each limb steps, in the units of the animal (leg lengths, hips' heights, shares of a cycle). Where each comes from: corpus_dinosaurs.sources.json. Made by soma/tools/clip_scan.js and clip_collect.js.
